title: Birth in Little Washington, running away at fourteen
summary: Born August 20, 1900 in Little Washington, NC; he ran away at fourteen to join the A.G. Allen Minstrel Show because he loved drums, which his mother disliked; his father died when he was a baby.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Fred Moore, you were born in the year 1900.
What is your date of birth and where were you born?
I was born in Little Washington, North Carolina. My age is, I was born 1900, and my birthday is August the 20th.

I ran away from home when I was fourteen years old, just to try to entertain the people, but I was a little bit too young. I was with this minstrel show for a long time, about...oh, about a couple of years, a year. The A.G. Allen Minstrel Show.
A.G. Allen. Well, Fred, what caused you to run away. I mean, you wanted to get involved in entertainment of some sort?

I wanted to get involvement with entertainment, but I didn't know what it was all about. I loved drums so much. Around the house, I used to hit on the different frying pans, anything I could get a sound from. I used to take the rungs out the old chairs, just whittle them down on the end to make a drumstick.
How did your mother feel about that and your father?
She wasn't too happy. My father wasn't living then.

My father died when I was very young. I think my father died when I was around nine weeks, nine months old or something like that. I don't remember, it's been so long, but... But my mother wasn't too happy about me making all that noise in the house, you know.
